title: Hushed Moroccan Carrot Tagine
description: A fragrant, light Moroccan carrot tagine infused with full-fat sour cream and sweet dried fruit, perfect for a romantic date night.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a tagine or heavy pot over medium heat.
Add diced onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger, sauté until onion translucent.
Stir in cumin, coriander, and smoked paprika, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add sliced carrots and chopped dried fruit mix, stir to coat with spices.
Pour in vegetable broth and lemon juice, bring to a gentle simmer.
Cover and reduce heat to low, cook for 25 minutes until carrots are tender.
Remove from heat, stir in full fat sour cream until smooth and creamy.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Let the tagine rest for 5 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Serve hot, optionally garnish with chopped fresh cilantro.
